description: This Java source file defines the ComponentContainer class, which implements a startup container for loading components in the OFBiz framework. It manages component initialization, loading from directories or configuration files, and dependency sorting.

classes.name: ComponentContainer
classes.description: Implements a container that loads components for the OFBiz framework, managing their initialization and dependencies.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with commands, name, and configuration file, delegating to another init method.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Loads components from a specified directory, ensuring they are loaded only once.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns whether the container has been successfully loaded.

methods.name: loadComponent
methods.description: Loads a specific component based on its definition, either as a directory or a single component.

methods.name: loadComponentDirectory
methods.description: Loads components from a directory, checking for a load file or loading all subdirectories.

methods.name: loadComponentsInDirectoryUsingLoadFile
methods.description: Loads components listed in a load file (component-load.xml) from a directory.

methods.name: loadComponentsInDirectory
methods.description: Loads all components in a directory that do not have a load file, sorted alphabetically.

methods.name: retrieveComponentConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the component configuration for a given directory path.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container.
